statement: The proportion of mothers with fewer than five prenatal visits is higher among SUID cases compared to the general population.
rationale: This design compares the prevalence of low prenatal healthcare utilization between SUID cases and a representative sample of live births, using data from overlapping periods covered by all sources.
prior_art: None in the inputs. Previous studies have examined various risk factors for SUID but do not directly address healthcare utilization during pregnancy.
cannot_establish: The design cannot establish causality or estimate incidence rates directly. It can only compare the prevalence of prenatal healthcare visits between SUID cases and a representative sample of live births.
